notes.title: v1.0.0.7
notes.content:
Changes:
- Tweaked the resolution option.
- Added a fullscreen option.
- Fixed a number of bugs.
- Generally improved performance.

Expect something bigger to come soon...

notes.title: v1.0.0.6
notes.content:
Changes:
- Added pixel-scaling feature that automatically scales pixels depending on your resolution (this makes things smoother).
- Fixed multiple bugs related to the UI and inputs.
- Generally improved performance.

notes.title: v1.0.0.5
notes.content:
Changes:
- Added 4 new tenants.
- Added tooltips that specify the details of tenants' stats.
- Added the perk section to tenants' cards that specifies their abilities.
- Workbench cells in the cellar tab now turn dark if one doesn't have enough resources listed in them.
- Tweaked player's interactions during the tutorial section of the game.
- Fixed some typos and bugs.

notes.title: v1.0.0.4
notes.content:
Changes:
- Compressed several audio files, making the game occupy significantly less disc space.
- Added a "Preemptive Shutdown" button that is available during the intro sequence of the game.
- Fixed some typos and bugs.

notes.title: v1.0.0.3
notes.content:
Changes:
- Removed the Coconut item.
- Fixed an issue preventing Milk from being discovered during expeditions.
- Added crafting tabs for the cellar window.
- Added a potions mechanic (along with 4 potion items).
- Added 5 new status effects.
- Added a weather mechanic.
- Added item rarity.
- Rebalanced the drop amount of different items depending on their rarity.
- Fixed some typos and bugs.

notes.title: v1.0.0.2
notes.content:
Changes:
- Removed the Silicon item.
- Changed crafting recipes of items that previously contained Silicon in them.
- Fixed an issue preventing Wheat from being discovered during expeditions.
- Added resolution support for screens bigger that 1080p.
- By popular demand, added an option to cook certain types of meat.
- Changed the randomization settings for expeditions' rewards (meaning that chances of finding different items are more or less equalized now).
- Fixed some typos and bugs.

notes.title: v1.0.0.1
notes.content:
Changes:
- Added a graphical representation for status effects.
- Added a specific bridge generation for new sessions.
- Fixed some typos and bugs.
